mg.title: Hook text

text.main: Are you going to ask me for money?

mg.cue: Top text from frame 1, top third: “Are you going to ask me for money?” (her words).
mg.use: Gori's words as top text in the top third. It cuts on with no animation. Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:05.5.

mg.title: The question

text.main: Would you ever help someone that you've never met before?

mg.cue: Then the question as top text: “Would you ever help someone that you've never met before?” Stays 5 s.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05.5, when the hook text goes out. Top third, hold it 5 seconds.
